findings.description: A lounge has opened on the mezzanine of Le Parc Bistrobar, the existing restaurant at 185 Sutter Street.

citation.label: What Now San Francisco, “Bar Antoine Lounge Now Open in San Francisco,” 10 September 2026

raw.text: Bar Antoine Lounge, located at 185 Sutter Street, is open Tuesday through Friday

publish.note: Fails the ten-year test: an existing restaurant adding a lounge within its own space is not a change of occupancy. Hoodline's rewrite, 2026-09-10-hl-0004, is declined on the same grounds.
